figures_added.what: Inline theme-safe SVG of a chocolate bar divided into 6 equal squares, backing the 'show what you say' common-denominator hook. Uses currentColor strokes and soft amber fill-opacity 0.3; no external refs; ~750 chars.

notes: Fractions is a textual/pure-calculation topic: GCSE exam papers do not print a figure for problems like 'calculate 1/4 + 1/3', so no problem-level SVG or Chart.js figures were added (that would be decoration, which SPEC_DIAGRAMS forbids). The one legitimate figure is the opener bar model, which makes the concrete pizza/bar hook actually visible per Tom's 'show what you say' rule. Figure numbers verified against the opener text: 6 squares shown = the 6 the student reasons over; a half = 3 squares, plus 1 = 4 of 6 = 2/3.
